attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 5, `qmcA` to `copA`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent. The model names 89 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 3, `ybaT`, 89%.

**A single variable column breaks the first spine**: column 6, `ybaQ`, shell, carried by 80%, the most plastic stretch of the window. Further along the long spine, columns 56 to 60, `cyoA` to `cyoE`, are [[cytochrome o ubiquinol oxidase]]. The last stretch, columns 69 to 79, is fork and variable, carried by 48 to 90%.

**Here the model hesitates more on the spine than off it**, 0.22 against 0.13 bits, while naming 97% of genes on both. Its most hesitant column, 10, `fsr`, is a spine column, at 0.59 bits.

**The window ends on persistent families.** Columns 69 to 79, `yajO` to `secF`, are carried from 90 to 48% of chromosomes. They are not rare: in the other chromosomes they lie beyond the window's end.

**Across the window it names 97% of genes**, 0.20 bits on average, perplexity 1.2 families. Only 2,177 of the 42,960 calls fall in a region of plasticity, where it hesitates more, 1.54 against 0.13 bits, and names fewer genes, 69% against 98%.

label: qmcA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the qmcA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor qmcA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,221 to 3,300 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying qmcA once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 97% of genes, 0.20 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,712 calls, named 99%, 0.12 bits; shell 2,942 calls, named 71%, 0.92 bits; cloud 306 calls, named 28%, 4.36 bits. Outside an RGP 40,783 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 2,177 calls, named 69%, 1.54 bits. Columns: 67 spine, 1 fork, 12 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.54 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (69% against 98%); 2,177 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 10 (fsr, a spine column) 0.59 bits, RGP 17%; column 9 (ushA, a spine column) 0.56 bits, RGP 20%; column 32 (pdeB, a spine column) 0.48 bits, RGP 2%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 67 spine columns: named 97%, 0.22 bits on average; the 13 fork and variable columns: named 97%, 0.13 bits. The model names about as many genes on the spine columns as on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates more there. Its most hesitant column, 10, is a spine column: the model can hesitate most inside a spine.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 6 (variable), RGP 19%; the least: columns 69-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 1-2%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-5 (6 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-19%. Genes: qmcA, ybbJ "NfeD family protein", cueR, ybaT "APC family permease", glsA, copA. named 89-99.8% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 3 (ybaT), named 89%; most hesitant at column 2 (cueR), 0.44 bits.
[S2] 2. column 6 variable: share 80%, all S, RGP 19%. named 94%; 0.23 bits.
[S2.c6]    6: ybaQ S 80% "HigA family addiction module antito…"
[S3] 3. columns 7-24 (18 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 2-21%. Genes: ybaP "TraB/GumN family protein", ybaK "Cys-tRNA(Pro)/Cys-tRNA(Cys) deacyla…", ushA, fsr, ybaL "YbaL family putative K(+) efflux tr…", gsk, aes, hemH, adk, htpG, recR, ybaB "YbaB/EbfC family nucleoid-associate…", dnaX, apt, ybaN "DUF454 family protein", priC, rsmS, mscK. named 78-99% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 8 (ybaK), named 78%; most hesitant at column 10 (fsr), 0.59 bits.
[S4] 4. column 25 variable: share 90%, all P, RGP 3%. named 96%; 0.37 bits.
[S4.c25]    25: acrR P 90% "multidrug efflux transporter transc…"
[S5] 5. columns 26-68 (43 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 1-7%. Genes: acrA, acrB, tomB, hha, maa, ylaC "YlaC family protein", pdeB, ybaA "DUF1428 domain-containing protein", ybaZ "MGMT family protein", ybaY "YbaY family lipoprotein", tesB, amtB, glnK, mdlB "SmdB family multidrug efflux ABC tr…", mdlA, decR, cof, ybaE "SgrR family transcriptional regulat…", queC, fadM, ybaV "helix-hairpin-helix domain-containi…", ppiD, hupB, lon, clpX "ATP-dependent protease ATP-binding…", clpP, tig, bolA, yajG "lipoprotein", ampG, cyoA, cyoB "cytochrome o ubiquinol oxidase subu…", cyoC, cyoD, cyoE, yajR "MFS transporter", yajQ "nucleotide binding protein YajQ", panE, yajL "protein deglycase YajL", thiI, xseB, ispA, dxs. named 94-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 61 (yajR), named 94%; most hesitant at column 32 (pdeB), 0.48 bits.
[S6] 6. columns 69-79 (11 columns) fork and variable columns: share 48-90%, all P, RGP 1-2%. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 69, named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.16 bits (column 69).
[S6.c69-77]    columns 69-77 variable, share 59-90%, all P: yajO "1-deoxyxylulose-5-phosphate synthas…" 90%, pgpA 87%, thiL 82%, nusB 78%, ribH 74%, ribD "bifunctional diaminohydroxyphosphor…" 71%, nrdR 69%, yajI "DUF3251 domain-containing protein" 65%, tsx 59%
[S6.c78]    78 fork: yajD P 53% "HNH nuclease YajD"; also espY3 S 11%
[S6.c79]    79 variable: secF P 48%
[Q] GROUPS whose products agree, the places for a [[ ]] (name that group's columns exactly, cite its line and [Q], make one phrase from its words): columns 25-27 (acrR to acrB) [S4, S5]: efflux, transporter, multidrug; columns 37-40 (amtB to mdlA) [S5]: transporter, multidrug, permease; columns 56-60 (cyoA to cyoE) [S5]: cytochrome, oxidase, ubiquinol; columns 67-69 (ispA to yajO) [S5, S6]: synthase, phosphate.
